networks.name: pide_el_expediente
networks.description: Drafts a request under Spain's transparency law to see the files of public contracts. For a body's contracts just under the legal limit, it asks Al límite's agents, after you agree.
sample_queries: Draft a request for the files of the Ayuntamiento de Ourense's contracts just under the limit.
Put the 3 newest contracts of the Diputación Provincial de Ourense just under the limit in the request.
Where do I file the request, and how long do they have to answer?
Can you file the request for me?

peer_policy.note: Calls only the partner sites in allowed_peers (Al límite), after the visitor agrees.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
